name: CEXISWAP initialize() callable by anyone hands over the UUPS upgrade right
summary: CEXISWAP 0xb8a5890d accepted a second call to its initialize(), which set the caller as admin, and its UUPS upgradeToAndCall then let that admin switch the implementation. The attacker's contract re-initialized it, upgraded to itself, transferred the contract's 30,000 USDT out through the delegatecall, and self-destructed.
notes: Anchored on the re-initialization, the victim defect that made the attacker's upgrade possible (rule 10); its installed code is part of the attack. The contract had been initialized in its 2021 deployment block and was not changed after.
